name: The Best of Thor
description: As Journey into Mystery turns into Thor, Asgard's stories go cosmic, and these selections carry them to the War of the Realms. Kirby's cosmic run brings Ego, the High Evolutionary and Mangog, then Firelord and Simonson's Surtur Saga with Beta Ray Bill. Ragnarok, Asgard over Oklahoma, Jason Aaron's God Butcher and Malekith stories and a new Thor's run lead to the finale.
sourceOrigin: Compiled for this project from Comic Book Herald's guide
